title: JuraTax en ligne (JuraTax Online 2025)

notes: States the return can be completed 100% online and signed with SwissID; access via the Guichet virtuel. Does not mention third-party software. Says electronic tax statements (eRelevés) can pre-fill data.

title: JuraTax Logiciel 2025
publisher: Service des contributions, République et Canton du Jura
why_needed: Official free desktop program for 2025 and its upload route
notes: Version 1.1.0 dated 22.01.2026. Downloads for Windows 64-bit, macOS and Linux. Internet connection needed to upload. Page warns against using older editions for 2025. No certified third-party products are listed.

title: Guichet virtuel pour les fiduciaires
publisher: Service des contributions, République et Canton du Jura
why_needed: Only official statement on fiduciary and mandataire filing, which answers the third-party software question
notes: Fiduciaries file through JuraTax Online using taxpayer number and Code-DI for the tax year. Each staff member needs a personal SwissID. No approved third-party software list. Three how-to PDFs are linked and were not read.
